description: This file defines an interface in PHP for accessing configuration related to AWS SDK default modes. It specifies several methods for retrieving configuration properties such as mode, regional endpoints, and timeouts.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface that provides methods to access various default mode configurations for AWS SDK.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the configuration mode, such as 'legacy', 'standard', or 'adaptive'.

methods.name: getStsRegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns whether STS regional endpoints are enabled.

methods.name: getS3UsEast1RegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns whether S3 US-East-1 regional endpoints are enabled.

methods.name: getConnectTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the connection timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: getHttpRequestTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
